units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 7:3">Gitt. VII, 3</cite>, a. fr. <he>אם מַתִּי</he> if I should die.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 9:5">Gen. R. s. 9</cite> (play on <cite ref="M00005"><he>מְאֹד</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 1:31">Gen. I, 31</cite>) <he>והנה טזב מוֹת</he> behold, it is good to die.—
<cite ref="Kiddushin 72b:2">Kidd. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>כשמֵת ר׳ וכ׳</he> when R … died.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:5">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מת פתאום</he> if one dies suddenly.
<cite ref="Shabbat 55b:2">Sabb. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>בחטאם מֵתוּ</he> died for their sin.
<cite ref="Tamid 32a:44">Tam. 32ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>מה יעביד אינש ויָמוֹת וכ׳</he> what must man do in order to die? Let him feed himself, v. <cite ref="E00230"><he>הָיָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shevuot 18a">Shebu. 18ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="F00029"><he>וָטוּב</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—V. <cite ref="M03002"><he>מֵת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to put to death; to cause death.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 53a:9">Snh. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>אם אי אתה יכול לַהֲמִיתוֹ … שאתה מֵמִיתוֹ וכ׳</he> that if you cannot put him to death in the manner legally prescribed, you must execute judgment by whatever means you can.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 56b:12">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>דברים … מְמִיתִין עליהן</he> acts on which a Jewish court passes a sentence of death. Tam. l. c. (in Chald. dict.) <he>מה יעבד אינש … יָמִית עצמו</he> what must man do in order to live?… Let him starve himself (his appetites).

<cite ref="Berakhot 63b:14">Ber. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>אין ד״ת … שממית עצמו עליה</he> the words of the Law remain only with him who kills himself (denies himself all enjoyments) for its sake (with play on <cite ref="Numbers 19:14">Num. XIX, 14</cite>); a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Ketubot 37b">Keth. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>מוּמָתִין בסייף</he> those put to death by the sword.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 55b:6">Snh. 55ᵇ</cite> <he>מומתין על ידה</he> are put to death on her account; a. fr.
